fieldValues.title: AI agent in Agent memory
fieldValues.summary: An agent that starts every session from scratch and relies on recalling the few records that matter, with where each came from, to continue earlier work.
goals: Recall only the records the task needs
Know where every recalled record came from
Pick up where an earlier session or agent left off
jobs: Recall the few records relevant to the task
Check where a claim came from
Know which build and environment it is acting through
Write records without breaking contracts or overwriting another writer
Hand work over to a human or another agent
fieldValues.needs: Fast scoped recall that answers plain questions, provenance on everything, honest errors, and write tools that enforce type and relation contracts.
